allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Force | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter README.md | ForEach-Object { "===== $\($_.FullName\)"; Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem go.mod, package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime; foreach \($f in 'go.mod','package.json','pyproject.toml'\) { "===== $f"; Get-Content $f -Raw })
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Force -Directory | Where-Object Name -match 'k2' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; "cmd/k2 items: " + @\(Get-ChildItem cmd\\k2 -Force -Recurse\).Count)
